# Sanic Server with Logging and Telemetry

## Description
A lightweight Python server built using the Sanic framework, featuring:
- Structured logging
- Telemetry with Prometheus
- Easy containerization via Docker

---

## Running the Server with Docker

### Prerequisites
Ensure Docker is installed on your system.

### Steps to Build and Run
Navigate to the AI server folder and execute the following commands:

```bash
# Build the Docker image
docker build -t sanic .

# Run the container
docker run -d -p 8000:8000 --name server sanic
```

After running, all linked methods should connect from Postman to `localhost:8000`.

---

## Running Ollama Using Docker

```bash
# Run Ollama container
docker run -d --name ollama -p 11434:11434 ollama/ollama

# Pull the required model
docker exec -it ollama ollama pull llama2:7b  # Change to your desired model

# Run with persistence
docker run -d --gpus=all --name ollama -p 11434:11434 -v ollama_data:/root/.ollama ollama/ollama
```

---

## Connecting Ollama and Sanic Server

After both containers are running, create a Docker bridge network:

```bash
# Create a network
docker network create server_bridge

# Connect both containers
docker network connect server_bridge ollama
docker network connect server_bridge server

# Verify connection
docker network inspect server_bridge
```

---


# OR

## Run docker-compose.yml

After loading the source code into the desired location navigate to Main folder (AI services and run below). Docker is must for below function

```bash 
# To Run everything 
docker-compose up --build
# If running for the first time , you will need to wait on the download of the model to complete
```

## Installation & Local Setup

### Install Dependencies
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### Run Locally
1. **Create a virtual environment:**
   ```bash
   python -m venv venv
   source venv/bin/activate  # On Windows: venv\Scripts\activate
   ```

2. **Run the Sanic server:**
   ```bash
   python main.py
   ```

---

## Project Structure
```
Ai Service/
├── app/
│   ├── __init__.py          # Package initialization
│   ├── server.py            # Application entry point
│   ├── routes.py            # API routes/endpoints
│   ├── logger.py            # Logging methods
│   ├── config.py            # Configuration settings
│   ├── models.py            # Database models (if applicable)
│   ├── telemetry.py         # Telemetry and metrics setup
│   └── utils.py             # Utility/helper functions
├── Prompt Repository/       # Folder to hold relevant prompts 
│   └── prompt.json          # Prompts can be modified here
├── logs/
│   ├── server.log              # Application logs
├── tests/
│   ├── test_main.py         # Unit tests for main app
├── .env                     # Environment variables
├── Dockerfile               # Dockerfile for containerization
├── requirements.txt         # Python dependencies
├── README.md                # Documentation
└── setup.py                 # Optional: For packaging
```
